architecture: Sentinel is a production-grade, real-time fraud detection MLOps platform built on an event-driven microservices architecture. The core design follows a layered pipeline: (1) Data Ingestion Layer — Kafka for high-throughput transaction streaming and Redis Streams for low-latency in-memory event buffering; (2) Processing Layer — FastAPI microservices for feature engineering, rule-based scoring, and ML inference; (3) Intelligence Layer — LangChain/LlamaIndex agents for semantic analysis and RAG-based fraud investigation, Neo4j graph database for fraud ring detection, and vector databases (Milvus/ChromaDB) for embedding-based anomaly detection; (4) Persistence Layer — PostgreSQL for transactional metadata, Redis for hot feature serving, and object storage (MinIO) for model artifacts; (5) Orchestration Layer — Apache Airflow for scheduled retraining pipelines and Kubernetes for production container orchestration. The system achieves sub-100ms fraud scoring latency with a hybrid detection approach combining rule-based engines, ML models, and graph-based connected-entity analysis.

microservices.reasoning: Async-native, high throughput (200k+ daily users, 80 req/s), automatic OpenAPI docs, Pydantic validation
microservices.alternatives: Flask (simpler but slower), Spring Boot (Java, heavier but battle-tested in banking)

event_streaming.role: High-throughput transaction ingestion, pub/sub between microservices, replayable event log
Low-latency in-memory event buffering, velocity checks, sliding window aggregates

relational.role: Transaction metadata, user accounts, model registry, audit logs
relational.extension: pgvector for lightweight vector search (up to ~10M vectors)

milvus.role: Billion-scale vector search, embedding-based anomaly detection, RAG retrieval
milvus.strengths: Distributed architecture, separate compute/storage scaling, hybrid search (vector + keyword + metadata)
milvus.deployment: Milvus Standalone (tens of M vectors) or Distributed (hundreds of M+) via Kubernetes

chromadb.strengths: Embedded mode (no server), simple API, built-in embeddings
chromadb.limitation: Not designed for horizontal scaling beyond ~10M vectors

vector_db.recommendation: Use Milvus for production at scale; ChromaDB for prototyping or small deployments

in_memory.role: Hot feature store (Feast online store), session state, rate limiting, sliding window fraud checks
in_memory.module: RedisJSON, RediSearch for vector similarity in-memory

graph.role: Fraud ring detection, entity resolution, multi-hop relationship analysis, connected-party risk scoring

langchain.role: Multi-step fraud investigation agents, tool orchestration, RAG pipelines, explainable AI reasoning chains
langchain.strengths: Agent patterns (Zero-shot ReAct), tool integration, memory management, multi-agent orchestration
langchain.best_for: Complex fraud workflows requiring reasoning, tool calling, and audit trails

llamaindex.role: Document-heavy compliance monitoring, regulatory filing analysis, semantic search over fraud knowledge bases
llamaindex.strengths: Superior retrieval accuracy, efficient caching, source traceability for compliance
llamaindex.best_for: RAG over financial documents, regulatory text search, cost-optimized deployments

llm_agent_frameworks.recommendation: LangChain for agent-driven fraud investigation; LlamaIndex for document retrieval and compliance RAG

tesseract.role: Fast CPU-only OCR for clean printed documents, invoices, receipts
tesseract.strengths: 10MB install, 3x faster on CPU, no GPU required, 100+ languages

easyocr.role: High-accuracy OCR for complex, noisy, multi-language, or handwritten documents
easyocr.strengths: Deep learning pipeline, 80+ languages, GPU acceleration, structured output with confidence scores

engines.production_pattern: Dual-engine routing: Tesseract for clean documents (speed), EasyOCR for difficult ones (accuracy). Use a lightweight classifier (image entropy, resolution check) to route.

preprocessing.pipeline: Grayscale → CLAHE contrast boost → Denoise (Gaussian/bilateral) → Adaptive threshold → Skew correction → Deskew
preprocessing.postprocessing: NLP-based entity extraction (spaCy, regex) for structured fields (invoice #, amount, date)

lightweight.role: Static HTML merchant reputation data, review aggregation, price monitoring

scrapy.role: Large-scale structured scraping, merchant profile aggregation, complaint database mining
scrapy.strengths: Built-in item pipelines, middleware for retries/IP rotation, async support

dynamic_content.role: JavaScript-rendered merchant sites, real-time reputation data

web_scraping.fraud_specific: Scrape BBB complaints, consumer review sites, chargeback databases, and merchant rating platforms to build reputation scores

ml_frameworks.training: scikit-learn (RandomForest, XGBoost, LightGBM), imbalanced-learn (SMOTE for class imbalance)
ml_frameworks.monitoring: Prometheus + Grafana for model drift, latency, and throughput

containerization.pattern: Multi-stage builds, non-root users, slim base images (python:3.10-slim), .dockerignore for security

orchestration.development: Docker Compose (9+ services: API, MLflow, Airflow, PostgreSQL, Redis, Milvus, Neo4j, MinIO, Streamlit)

k8s_components.deployments: Stateless FastAPI services, MLflow server, Airflow workers
k8s_components.statefulsets: PostgreSQL, Redis, Milvus coordinators/data/query nodes, Neo4j
k8s_components.services: ClusterIP for internal, LoadBalancer/Ingress for API gateway
k8s_components.configmaps_secrets: Environment variables, API keys, database credentials

deployment.ci_cd: GitHub Actions for build/test/deploy, ArgoCD for GitOps deployment

implementation_patterns: Event-Driven Microservices Architecture: Kafka pub/sub decouples ingestion, processing, and alerting services
Dual-Engine OCR Routing: Lightweight classifier routes documents to Tesseract (speed) or EasyOCR (accuracy) based on image quality metrics
Feature Store Pattern (Feast): Unified offline (Parquet) and online (Redis) feature serving to prevent training-serving skew
RAG-Based Fraud Investigation: LangChain agents retrieve historical fraud cases from Milvus/ChromaDB to provide context-aware investigation reports
Graph-Based Fraud Ring Detection: Neo4j Cypher queries identify connected entities sharing phone/email/device — constant-complexity vs exponential SQL self-joins
Multi-Layer Fraud Scoring: Rule engine (velocity checks, blacklist) + ML model (anomaly score) + Graph score (ring membership) → weighted ensemble
Sliding Window Aggregates: Redis Streams + Redis Sorted Sets for real-time transaction velocity, amount anomaly, and geo-improbability checks
Hybrid Search in Vector DB: Milvus supports vector similarity + metadata filters + full-text keyword search for comprehensive fraud pattern matching
MLflow Model Registry: Version-controlled model deployment with A/B testing support and automatic rollback on drift detection
Circuit Breaker Pattern: Resilience4j or pybreaker for downstream service failures (e.g., OCR service timeout → fallback to cached result)
Dead Letter Queue (DLQ): Kafka DLQ for failed fraud events requiring manual investigation
Semantic Cache (CacheGPT): Milvus-backed semantic cache stores LLM responses to reduce API costs and latency on repeated queries
Zero-Shot ReAct Agent: LangChain agents reason through fraud investigations step-by-step, calling tools (APIs, DB queries) autonomously
Dual-Index Strategy: pgvector for lightweight vector search in PostgreSQL (development) → Milvus for production scale
Immutable Audit Trail: All fraud decisions logged to PostgreSQL with model version, features used, and confidence score for compliance
